title: docs(skills): teach that a column with no value fails an ordering filter, and where a per-measure filter runs

_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9NXd2SJ1z5XQzawbhD1qEaF)_

Fixes #33868

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:查询技能新增一条规则「没有值的列(null 或缺失)不满足任何大小比较(`$gt/$gte/$lt/$lte/$between`)」,并改正了「带 filter 的度量一定走内存」这句已过时的话(声明 `aggregationFilter` 的驱动在数据库里算),另加一条评测用例。
- 为什么改:#33854 已改变运行时行为;不教的话,作者和 AI 会以为 `amount $lte 0` 也会把没填金额的记录算进去,仪表盘上的数字会被误读,且技能还在说一句已经不成立的话。
- 风险与回滚:只改技能文档、一条 eval 和一个 changeset,不动运行时代码;回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看:`skills/objectstack-query/rules/aggregation.md`(Filtered Aggregation 提示块,措辞最接近契约承诺)→ `rules/filters.md`(新规则一节,以及为付账删掉的两处重复)→ `evals/filters-pagination-search.json` 第 8 条。
- 两分钟验证:`node scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs`,预期全绿,filters.md 显示 `2473 / 2473`、aggregation.md 显示 `2264 / 2357`。
- 需要你做的:批准本 draft(受管面 Tier H)。

## What changes

The query skill now teaches two things PR #33854 made true, and drops one sentence it made false.

`skills/objectstack-query/rules/filters.md` (published, English):

- **New section "A column with no value fails every ordering test"** (it replaces "Prefer `$null` to a bare `null` comparand", whose rule is kept as its last sentence): `$gt` / `$gte` / `$lt` / `$lte` / `$between` never match a row whose column is null or absent, in `where`, an aggregation's `filter` and `having` alike; `{ amount: { $lte: 0 } }` skips the rows with no amount, and an `$or` with `{ amount: { $null: true } }` keeps them. `null` is not an ordering comparand (`{ $gte: null }` is refused `INVALID_FILTER` / 400).
- **Paid for in the same file** by two restatements: the case-sensitivity paragraph, whose rule `SKILL.md` § String Operators carries ("compare CASE-SENSITIVELY; `$icontains` is the case-INSENSITIVE twin (ASCII folding only)"), now a one-line pointer; and the second Date example (`$between` over two `Date`s), whose home is the operator table's `$between` row plus the `$gte: new Date(…)` example kept directly above it. Lost with no home: the `café` / `CAFÉ` illustration of ASCII-only folding (the rule survives in SKILL.md).

`skills/objectstack-query/rules/aggregation.md`:

- **§ Filtered Aggregation:** the callout no longer says any filtered measure "forces the in-memory path — no driver compiles a conditional aggregate, and one reached directly refuses `NOT_IMPLEMENTED`". A driver that declares `supports.aggregationFilter` (`driver-sql`; `driver-turso` outside remote mode) runs the filter in the database whenever the aggregate itself is pushed down (a date bucket under a non-UTC `timezone`, or a granularity the driver does not bucket natively, keeps the whole call in memory: `tzRequiresInMemory` and `allStructuredSupported` sit in the same route condition), compiled as that datasource's `where` is: it answers what the same condition answers there (text by the database collation) and is refused where it is (the pinned case: a `{ $field }` comparison on a column the object does not declare, `INVALID_FILTER` / 400). On any other driver the engine reads the scoped rows and evaluates the filter itself; no answer is promised beyond that. A column with no value fails its ordering tests either way.
- **§ HAVING:** `avg` / `min` / `max` over no values is `null`, so `having: { average: { $lte: 0 } }` drops that group.

`skills/objectstack-query/evals/filters-pagination-search.json`: case 8, one aggregate call returning the total and the count of deals whose `amount` is zero or less, where a deal with no amount must count. `must_contain`: `filter`, `$or`, `$lte: 0`, `$null: true`; `must_not_contain` is empty, so no correct answer that restates the rule can trip it. Spliced with the file's hand formatting kept.

`skills/objectstack-ui/rules/dashboards.md` is untouched: it never states how a measure filter is evaluated (it only lists "measure-scoped filters" as fitting a dataset).

`.changeset/33868-skills-no-value-ordering-measure-filter.md`: `'@objectstack/skills': patch`.

Every taught fact is read from origin/main at or after `0ac112fc`:

- `packages/objectql/src/having-filter.ts`: `NULL_IS_NOT_ORDERED_OPERATORS = new Set(['$gt', '$gte', '$lt', '$lte', '$between'])`; in `checkCondition`, `if (value === undefined && !NO_VALUE_ANSWERED_BY_OPERATOR.has(op)) return false;` then `if (value === null && NULL_IS_NOT_ORDERED_OPERATORS.has(op) && !orderingComparandHoldsNull(op, target)) return false;`. Pinned by `having-filter-null-ordering.test.ts` (each face, and the empty-group `having`) and `packages/rest/src/aggregate-measure-filter-pushdown.test.ts` ("a NULL amount fails an ordering filter on both paths").
- `packages/spec/src/data/filter.zod.ts` ("null is NOT a comparand: null is not ordered — state absence with the null predicate instead") and `filter-comparand-shape.ts` (`nullOrderingComparandError`, `INVALID_FILTER` / 400).
- `packages/objectql/src/engine-delete-and-aggregate.ts`: `const aggregationFilterNative = drv?.supports?.aggregationFilter === true;` and the `(!hasAggregationFilter || aggregationFilterNative)` route condition.
- `packages/drivers/driver-sql/src/sql-driver.ts` (`aggregationFilter: true`); `packages/drivers/driver-turso/src/turso-driver.ts` (`aggregationFilter: false` in remote mode); `packages/spec/src/data/driver.zod.ts` (the bit's describe text: text compares by the backend collation as in `where`).
- `packages/rest/src/aggregation-filter-where-doors.test.ts`: the `where` twin and the per-aggregation filter of `{ created_at: { $ne: { $field: 'photo' } } }` on an audit-opt-out object both answer `{ status: 400, code: 'INVALID_FILTER' }` on driver-sql.

## Tests

No code changed, so there is nothing to ablate. Gate readings are under Verification.

## Acceptance notes

- **Build tier, declared:** `dispatch-gates --tier` puts `skills/**` at the contract-review tier (clause ①). This card thread is served below it and cannot switch its own model, so (as the claim records) the authoring and the commit ran in an isolated os-dev subagent pinned to the contract-review tier inside this worktree; the merge of main, relay writes, gates and report ran in the thread.
- **Not taught, on purpose:** what `$ne` / `$nin` / `$notContains` answer on a column with no value (each answers a column with no value by its own arm, `NO_VALUE_ANSWERED_BY_OPERATOR`). It is a standing rule this card did not change; the card's list of unchanged operators also omits `$empty`, which the code keeps in the same set.
- **Refusal wording:** the skill names only the pinned refusal case. A plain undeclared key (`{ nope: 1 }`) answers `INVALID_FIELD`, not `INVALID_FILTER`, on both positions (row 4 of `aggregation-filter-where-doors.test.ts`), so "undeclared column ⇒ `INVALID_FILTER`" is not written bare.
- **NOT MEASURED:** `driver-mongodb` own `where` on a null column with `$lte` (no pin read; it rests on BSON type bracketing). `driver-memory` own `find` is pinned by `memory-matcher-null-value-and-comparand.test.ts` (#13553), per review 6897568297.
- Review round 1 (record 6897568297): S1 (pushdown clause), N1 ("no values") and N3 (row re-lock) taken in one commit, `b87277b6`, authored at the contract-review tier like the first; N2 left as is.
- Main was merged before each gate run (`a7754819`, `d47493ba`) so the derivation read a current tree.

## Verification

All readings are at head `d47493ba` (`git rev-parse --short HEAD` after the last commit), tree objectstack-ai/objectstack.

- Package build closure: `turbo run build --concurrency=2 --filter='./packages/**'` under `os-verify-lock.sh`, `VERDICT command-exit 0` (held 5m35s, after the first merge; the second merge touched only `scripts/pm/**` and `.claude/**`, nothing built).
